name: Skills Lab lists seeded skills, opens one, and shows its attachment on the agent
description: Loads /skills and confirms the seeded demo skills render as cards, opens lethal-trifecta — the FIRST card (the list is sorted by name and CI runs a short viewport, so a card further down is off-screen and agent-browser cannot click it) — (Config → Preview rendering its Markdown body → Versions history), then opens the Security Reviewer agent and confirms its Skills tab shows the seeded attachments ('3 of 6 enabled'). Read-only seeded data (no model call, no mutation, no drag/hover). Assumes a freshly seeded DB (server/src/db/seed-skills.ts): six skills, three enabled on Security Reviewer — guaranteed by the hermetic stack / e2e-web.yml; keep this flow's text in step with that seed.
